changeRecord.title: section swapped for a heavier one
changeRecord.whyItMatters: A heavier section looks safe, but stiffness attracts force: in an indeterminate structure the stiffer member takes a larger share of the moment, so the demands on the joints and on the neighbouring members change, and the member's own ratios drop -- a model that reports a comfortable ratio for a section that is not the one built.
changeRecord.precondition: a member for which a heavier section of the same kind exists (in the model or in the generic catalogue of the generators)

designRatioChangeAt.perturbedLimitState: compression: flexural buckling about the major axis (x)
